summary: The CriminalRecordsCheck functionality is part of the HSPnet user controls for managing student enrollment-related activities, particularly focusing on handling criminal records checks for enrolled students.
purpose: The purpose of the CriminalRecordsCheck module is to manage the enrollment process related to student criminal records checks. It provides functionalities for displaying, sorting, filtering, and updating criminal record check statuses and related student details.

workflows.name: Data Sorting and Filtering
steps: User selects sorting and filtering options.
System applies sort and filter to the grid data display.
Data is updated based on the selected criteria.

workflows.name: Edit Enrollment Entry
steps: User invokes the edit command for a specific enrollment entry.
System retrieves entry details and displays them in editable fields.
User modifies details and saves changes.

workflows.name: Save All Changes
steps: System iterates over all modified entries and applies updates to the database.

business_rules: If an enrollment entry is waived, override other actions with disabled state.
Only enrolled students not marked as graduated or inactive are considered for processing.
validations: UserSession must be valid for data operations to proceed.
Course and student details must be populated before actions can be taken.
system_behavior: System disables edit fields if the page is in a read-only state.
System hides certain UI elements based on the user's permissions and entry status.
